'''Crimson City''' (Japanese: '''ジョウチャンタウン''' ''Jōchan Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location believed to be in [[Kanto]]. It has not been visited by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, but is mentioned in ''[[EP077|The Fourth Round Rumble]]'' at [[Indigo Plateau]]. [[Jeanette Fisher]], who battled Ash on the Grass Field, comes from Crimson City.
